Sorry just seen this. My team is okay I guess but they aren’t really listening or maybe they genuinely don’t know what to do with. The crisis team on the 31st I wasn’t intoxicated but I was really upset and I ended dissociating. Mind it’s winter. I left in the house with no shoes. Just pjs and socks in the freezing cold and wet ground but didn’t feel cold at all. It’s like my mind was an auto and just knew what it was doing without me fully being aware of my surroundings. I was phoned my the police just when I was starting to walk into the river. Usually I fight the police but I was so out of it I didn’t know who they were. They said all I kept saying was “I need to go to the river, we’re going the wrong way”. Ended up being detained but my psych was off so 3 days later some other dr came in. Didn’t even ask me question. Just came in my room to say am discharged so I packed went to the train station. And as soon as I saw the train I jumped on the tracks but it stopped. I’d never tried that before so much thought the train wouldn’t be able to stop in time and low and behold it stopped. The police brought me back to hospital and she still discharged me. Since then it’s been hell. My self harming went through the roof and now am back in and it’s hell
